name: Shelah (son of Judah)
title: Ancestor of the Shelanites
summary: Shelah was the son of Judah and his Canaanite wife, the daughter of Shua. He became the ancestor of the Shelanites, one of the clans in the tribe of Judah. Shelah survived his older brothers Er and Onan, who both died because of their wickedness.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Shelah
keyEvents.description: Shelah was born as the third son to Judah and his Canaanite wife in Chezib.

keyEvents.title: Tamar Waits for Shelah
keyEvents.description: After Judah's two oldest sons died, Judah promised that Tamar would marry Shelah when he grew up, but Judah did not keep his promise.

keyEvents.title: Shela's descendants are mentioned
keyEvents.description: The sons of Shela and their clans are listed among the descendants of Judah who were registered in the census.

keyEvents.title: Shela's lineage in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Shela and their settlements are described, including craftsmen who worked for the king.
